THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between–
Mr. M. K. S. M. Dias, No. 598/B, Hirimbura Road, Galle of the one part
AND
Southern Province Road Development Authority, No. 19, Lower Dickson Road, Galle of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, S. B. Nawinna Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the IndustrialDisputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. K. A. T. Fernando, No. 42D,Colombo Road, Liyanagemulla, Seeduwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
S. B. NAWINNAMinister of Labour.
Colombo.15th July, 2015.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. M. K. S. M. Dias, No. 598/B, Hirimbura Road, Galle of the one part
AND
Southern Province Road Development Authority, No. 19, Lower Dickson Road, Galle of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is–

Whether the claim made by Mr. M. K. S. M. Dias working at the Southern Province Road Development Authority to be placed in the postof Technical Officer - 5(II) from 01.06.1990, Technical Officer - 5(I) from 01.06.1992 and Engineer - Grade 4 from 01.06.1997 in accordancewith the recruitment procedure of the Authority and to be paid all salary arrears in lieu of the higher grades of the Engineering Service inrespect of the period thereafter as well is just, and if so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGE,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 06th day of July, 2015.
